title: Substation Load Equilibrium
description: A power grid is distributed in a binary tree structure of substations. To ensure safety and prevent overloads, you must check if the grid is height-balanced. A binary tree substation network is height-balanced if the left and right subtrees of every node differ in height by no more than 1.
constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [0, 5000].
input_format: The root node of a binary tree.
output_format: A boolean value (true or false) indicating if the tree is height-balanced.

examples.explanation: Every node's left and right subtree heights differ by at most 1.
The left subtree of node 1 has height 3, while the right subtree has height 1, which exceeds the allowed difference of 1.
An empty tree is considered balanced.
